context: Aoi and Riku chat about a friend who studied abroad.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (若者/留学/成績/書店/出身) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 友達が、留学から帰ってきたよ。
lines.en: My friend came back from studying abroad.
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 同じ町の出身で、成績も優秀なんだ。
lines.en: From my town, and great grades too.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 若者が、世界を見るのはいいね。
lines.en: It's good for youth to see the world.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 留学先の本を、書店で探したよ。
lines.en: I looked for books from where they studied at the bookstore.
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 書店で、留学のコーナーあるの?
lines.en: Does the bookstore have a study-abroad section?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、若者向けの本が多かったよ。
lines.en: Yeah, lots of books for young people.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 成績を上げて、あなたも留学しなよ!
lines.en: Raise your grades and study abroad too!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm encouraging closing delivery throughout
